factual_claims.claim: The global market for AI-driven recruitment and hiring technology experienced significant growth in the years leading up to 2022.
President Joe Biden issued an executive order on AI on October 30, 2023.
The Digital Services Act (DSA) in Europe entered into force in February 2024.
New York City Local Law 144 became effective in July 2023.
Only 19 audits linked to NYC Local Law 144 were published in the first 6 months after it took effect.
The researchers gathered a corpus of 1,373 applications to K-12 teaching positions in a large public school district in Texas.
The researchers audited 11 different LLMs from OpenAI, Mistral, and Anthropic.
OpenAI's GPT-3.5 gave 20% of candidates an overall score of 5, 51% a 4, 24% a 3, 4% a 2, and 1% a 1.

In a study of LLM hiring preferences, researchers found that models rated synthetic female candidates and synthetic Black, Hispanic, and Asian candidates moderately higher than their respective counterparts.
